positions.title: Graduate Teaching Fellow
positions.description: - Teaching fellow (TF) for a digital logic and intro computer architecture course.

positions.title: Graduate Researcher
positions.description:
- Edge Computing Lab, advised by Prof. Vijay Janapa Reddi.
- Research in designing computer systems for robotics + computer vision applications.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Fellow
positions.description: - Teaching fellow (TF) for a digital logic and intro computer architecture course.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed software, hardware and FPGA-based circuits for space communications research and development projects, with a focus on digital signal processing and time transfer applications. 
- Played a central role in the FPGA design and development of the digital receiver of a time transfer modem.
- Involved in work centered around co-design of hardware and software systems on Xilinx SoCs (system on chips). 
- Designed hardware and FPGA-based circuits for the development of spacecraft avionics test equipment, with emphasis on streaming high throughput debug data to external devices.
- Involved in development of ground software and support of integration and test of software defined spacecraft radio systems for the NASA Europa Clipper and Lander missions.

company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Teaching Fellow
positions.description:
- Teaching fellow (TF) for an intro electronics and circuit design course, except for Fall 2016 semester, during which was a TF for computing hardware course. 
- Graded students' homework and assisted them during lab section. 
- Held weekly office hours, additional lab hours, and review sessions. 
- Classes ranged in size from 16 to 53 students.

positions.title: Course Assistant
positions.description:
- Course assistant for a section of a linear algebra and differential equations class (about 20 students). 
- Graded students' homework, assisted them with coursework, and ran a weekly review session.

positions.title: Robotics Institute Summer Scholar
positions.description:
- Designed, built, and tested an embedded management system for a small, mobile robot in the Field Robotics Center under Dr. Red Whittaker. 
- Embedded management system allows a remote operator to monitor the robot's internal diagnostic information, such as motor temperature, and control several low level functions, such as the emergency stop.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Assembled and deployed the TetraScience hardware product for customers. 
- Developed and investigated the use of new components for the TetraScience device. 
- Tested the TetraScience devices for reliability.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Contributed to high energy physics research with Professor Jesus Marcos de Lucas through the REAL study abroad program. 
- Worked on novel algorithms to analyze data from CERN particle collisions and identify new particles.
